clue.text: Exclusive group needing a measure of intelligence to crack one of these

indicators.note: to crack something is to break into it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the puzzle is made of clues, so 'one of these' is a clue
IQ, intelligence quotient, is the standard measure of intelligence

explanation.surface: Joining an elite set takes brains enough to solve one of these crossword puzzles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One of these' points at the crossword itself: the thing you are reading is a clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight, exclusive circle of people who keep others out is a clique.

clue.text: Companion aboard single ship where mystery lies beneath?

indicators.note: aboard means on board, inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: lone means single
CH is the abbreviation for Companion of Honour
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A companion on a lone ship sails where a mystery is hidden in the depths.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'mystery beneath' is the legendary monster said to live in this Scottish lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish lake is said to hide a monster beneath its waters, a famous mystery.

clue.text: See 26
Pass couple at rear of chancel going on to end of church

indicators.note: one piece follows the next
only the last two letters, a couple, of the word are kept

parts.note: the apse is the semicircular end of a church

explanation.surface: Walk past a pair at the back of the chancel to the end of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that passes or goes by is said to elapse.

clue.text: Number seven, 60% off with such a case

indicators.note: three of the five letters of the word, sixty per cent, are taken away, leaving the first two

parts.note: the dative is a grammatical case, as in Latin or German

explanation.surface: Seven, a big reduction off, appears to describe some sale or discount case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' is read as something that numbs, not a figure: a drug that dulls feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A calming drug numbs the senses, so it is something that makes you number, a numbing agent.

clue.text: Better half's home cooking required flour, say

definitions.note: the definition plays on flour sounding like flower

indicators.note: cooking means mixing things up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A partner's home baking needed flour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' rearranges BETTER HALF'S HOME; 'flour, say' means a flower, since the words sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: A white-flowered bulb plant of the lily family, a flower, which 'flour, say' indicates by sound.

clue.text: Extract the essence from article in singular fixture

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a denture, one set of false teeth, is a fixture in the mouth
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Take the essential part from a single article in a fixed piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To denature a substance is to strip it of its natural qualities, its essence.

clue.text: Narrow boat's stern squashing impressionist?

indicators.note: the stern is the back of a boat, so its last letter is taken

parts.note: an aper is a mimic, someone who does impressions

explanation.surface: A narrowboat's back end crushes an impressionist painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squashing' just says the boat's letter sits on top of the mimic in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrow gradually toward one end is to taper.

clue.text: Nationality of Soviet names established

indicators.note: the answer is made of letters from within these words

explanation.surface: A nationality is settled from Soviet names.
explanation.definitionFit: The people of a South-East Asian country, a nationality.

clue.text: The edge in jazz requires a series of models

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: scat is improvised wordless jazz singing
a hem is the edge of a piece of cloth

explanation.surface: Playing at the very edge of jazz needs a run of templates.
explanation.definitionFit: The plural of schema, a model or outline, so a set of such models or plans.

clue.text: Head found in bed?

definitions.meaning: someone napping, a dozer, is found in bed

explanation.definitionFit: Napper is slang for the head, and literally one who naps, often in bed.

clue.text: Person investigating about recovering alcoholic with one man's stimulant

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the investigator goes round the drinker

parts.note: a tester is someone who investigates or tries things out

indicators.note: recovering read as re-covering, turning back over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard

explanation.surface: An investigator deals with a drinker in recovery and a man taking a stimulant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recovering' is read as re-covering, turning back over, so the drinker is reversed before 'about' sets the investigator round it. 'man's stimulant' is the male hormone.
explanation.definitionFit: The male sex hormone, which stimulates male characteristics, is a man's stimulant in a loose sense.

clue.text: Exciting book, "The Musician's Aide"

definitions.meaning: a gripping read that keeps you turning
an assistant who flips sheet music for a performing pianist

explanation.definitionFit: Both a thrilling novel and the assistant who flips sheets for a pianist.

clue.text: Old Tibetan native knocked over, bringing end to fight

indicators.note: something knocked over is turned upside down, so the whole run is read backwards in this across clue

parts.note: the yak is native to Tibet

explanation.surface: An elderly yak from Tibet is toppled, finishing a brawl.
explanation.definitionFit: A kayo is a knockout, spelt from the letters KO, which ends a boxing fight.

clue.text: Sticky stuff makes porridge green

parts.note: porridge is British slang for a prison term, as is bird (from rhyming slang bird-lime, time)
lime is a shade of green

explanation.surface: A recipe claim: some sticky stuff turns porridge green.
explanation.walkthrough: Both PORRIDGE and BIRD are British slang for time in prison.
explanation.definitionFit: A sticky substance smeared on twigs to catch small birds is a classic gluey trap.

clue.text: Scene gets the point

parts.note: to land something is to get it
a cape is a point of land jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A scene earns its point.
explanation.definitionFit: A view of countryside is a landscape, a scene.

clue.text: A certain Benjamin's daughter, Netanyahu, perhaps

parts.note: Benjamin Netanyahu, Israeli prime minister, is an example of an Israeli

explanation.surface: A Benjamin's daughter, possibly a Netanyahu.
explanation.walkthrough: Both Benjamins: Benjamin Disraeli, Victorian British prime minister, and Benjamin Netanyahu.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Disraeli was the Victorian British prime minister, so a particular Benjamin.

clue.text: Wear this river, river wearing success

parts.note: the Tees is a river in north-east England

indicators.note: the success has the river letter on it, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a hit is a success
the Tees is a river in north-east England

explanation.surface: The Wear, a river in England, is called a river wearing success.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wear' looks like the English river (the Wear flows near the Tees) but is the definition: clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A casual short-sleeved top is an item of everyday clothing, which is wear.

clue.text: See 2
Bird gave cock nineteen hearts

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle, so each word gives its central letters

explanation.surface: A bird gave a rooster nineteen hearts.
explanation.definitionFit: A black-and-white wading bird with an upturned bill.

clue.text: Polish composer is smitten with surgeon's aid

parts.note: to rub is to polish
Alban Berg was an Austrian composer
to be smitten with someone is to love them

explanation.surface: A composer from Poland is besotted with a surgeon's helper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like a nationality but is the verb, RUB; the composer is Berg.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons wear thin latex hand coverings, so these protective items aid their work.

clue.text: See 22
Newspaper in Berlin, a complex centre for logistical activity

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other
complex means intricate or tangled, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times newspaper

explanation.surface: A paper in Berlin runs a complex hub for logistics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Logistical' plays on logical: the half of the brain held to handle logic. 'complex' gives LEBRAIN, and 'in' places the newspaper's letters within.
explanation.definitionFit: The left hemisphere is held to govern logical thought, a centre for reasoning.

clue.text: Person lacking freedom visiting China

parts.note: visiting somewhere means being in it
china is Cockney rhyming slang for mate (china plate)

explanation.surface: Someone without liberty is on a trip to China.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang 'china plate' means mate, so CHINA is a friend, not the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner is a person confined and lacking freedom.

clue.text: Crete has redistributed measures of land

indicators.note: the letters are handed out again in a new order

explanation.surface: Crete has shared out its land in new parcels.
explanation.definitionFit: Units of area, each ten thousand square metres, used to measure land.

clue.text: Well-off Oliver touring state is favouring friends

indicators.note: going round the state, so the trimmed name contains the other pieces
off means taken away, so the word is removed from the name

parts.note: Oliver Cromwell, Lord Protector of England
taken as written
NY is the abbreviation for New York state
taken as written

explanation.surface: A rich man named Oliver tours a state, showing favours to his pals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well-off' looks like 'rich' but splits: Oliver Cromwell with 'well' removed by 'off'. 'touring' then wraps the trimmed name round the state and 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving jobs and favours to one's pals is the practice of favouritism toward close friends.

clue.text: Score demanded in this game

parts.note: a score is ..., and in this parlour game players put a score of queries to guess an object

explanation.definitionFit: A guessing game where players may put up to a score of yes-or-no queries.
